gradeDescription: C = I needed a little help from the trainer.
whatIDidToday: played with as many buddies as possible
trainingSkills: sequence (3 different skills in varying order)
noteworthyComments: Today was a daily crazy day tons of energy and play throughout the day without a lot of calm. Most of us had a blast. And for our skills we worked on puppy push-ups (sit-down-up). Most of us did great and were very engaged. Overall fun day! Pepper was struggling a lot with the energy levels for most of the day. Wit overstimulated play as well as running after dogs barking at them if they wouldn’t play. Pepper did ok with separation but did much better with a hands free walk.
